results.title: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
results.overview: An engaging and thought-provoking look at Lucy Letby, the former nurse serving life in prison after being convicted of the murders of seven infants and the attempted murders of seven others.

results.title: Rage
results.overview: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

results.title: Intelligence Rising
results.overview: AI entrepreneur and new dad Marc Warner wants world leaders to take the risks of AI more seriously. He invites top thinkers like Gen. Stan McChrystal and Yuval Harari to play a wargame that simulates what could happen as AI gets more and more powerful over the coming decade.

results.title: FUN
results.overview: Kneading the back of an elderly man, Evie, the new masseuse at the Russian & Turkish bathhouse, finds her mind drifting from the steam room’s promise of serenity toward an absurd vision of grief.

results.title: Goody
results.overview: Guelia Pedat, raised Catholic by her overbearing mother, unknowingly suffers from OCD that manifests through an irrational adherence to religious rituals. After losing her faith and years after the death of her beloved older brother she still blames herself despite a lack of involvement.

results.title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
results.overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

results.title: The Arab
results.overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

results.title: The One
results.overview: Hawk, a Native American ex-foster youth, who visits Enid, Oklahoma for the tallest Christmas tree lighting. He bonds with locals and runaway teen Alexis while dealing with PTSD, anxiety, and self-discovery concerning his faith.

results.title: Red Flag
results.overview: The story follows the pilot Ahmed and his wife, an advertising company manager, highlighting the challenges of love, hesitation, trust, and infidelity in young couples’ relationships.

results.title: To Escape
results.overview: Built from classic prison films, To Escape follows a man’s relentless attempt to break free, turning a jailbreak into a story about the will to keep going.

results.title: Rak
results.overview: Having gone blind, Rak returns to live with Elsa, his ex-wife. Faced with a reality he cannot see, he slowly withdraws into the memory of what is no more. The poetic emancipation of a bird in its cage.

results.title: Madfabulous
results.overview: When the flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales to claim his aristocratic inheritance, his theatrical flair and defiant eccentricities send shockwaves through the upper-class elite, much to the amusement of the local townspeople. Alongside his spirited cousin, Lily, and loyal butler, Gelert, Henry tries to carve out his own identity as the Fifth Marquess, navigating suffocating traditions, scheming relatives, and the long shadow cast by his estranged father.

results.title: Death of Truth
results.overview: The orderly, solitary life of Feridun is shaken by the arrival of his old friend Timuçin, who carries the burden of murders they committed in the past. As Timuçin contemplates turning himself in, Feridun must stop him to protect his own freedom.

results.title: Gregor
results.overview: The discovery of a human skull fragment plunges Gregor into a hallucinatory thriller blending violence, power, and extreme fantasies...

results.title: Full Circle
results.overview: A mother and son search for the perfect vantage point to witness a total solar eclipse. Once totality hits, past, present and future become blurred.

results.title: Cannelloni
results.overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

results.title: The "Sea - Sea" Route
results.overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

results.title: Morro
results.overview: Veterinarian Mateo lives in grief following the death of his son. When he treats the injured dog of a local crime boss, the bond he forms with the animal helps him rediscover his purpose amidst the city's simmering violence.

results.title: John-Luke Roberts Distracts You From A Murder
results.original_title: John-Luke Roberts Distracts You From A Murder
results.overview: An hour of esoteric comedy performed to distract you from the murder John-Luke Roberts commits during the show.
